# The jolt

<!-- STEP id="jolt" -->
You sit in a bus. It starts suddenly from rest, and you feel a jolt. Later it stops suddenly, and you feel another jolt.

<!-- STEP id="two-readings" -->
Each jolt comes with a change in velocity. To find the change, read the velocity at two instants: here 0 km/h at the start and 36 km/h a few seconds later.
